title: F/A-18 Crash Recovery Command Post Build Up
description:
Marines from Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort, SC 
work with Airmen from Moody AFB 23d Civil Engineer Squadron to
set up a Command Post for the Recovery Team of a downed F/A-18
in Echols County Georgia
keywords: F/A-18 Hornet, crash, Moody, Marine jet, 23d Wing, plane, Civil Engineering
